paragraphs: Mentioned in Sukkah 45a: R' Yochanan reported in the name of R' Shimon HaMachozi, in the name of R' Yochanan HaMakhuti.[^1]

notes.text: מה. gives Sukkah 45a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification. The chain remains Yochanan, Shimon HaMachozi, Yochanan HaMakhuti; the two Yochanan occurrences are not silently merged or further identified. All four title occurrences remain R', without catalog רבי supplying an expansion.
